answer.summary: The change makes ObjectReaderImplList for java.util.Arrays$ArrayList carry instanceType=Arrays$ArrayList. This enables the JSONB fixed-size branch (L429) but breaks the text-JSON and Collection-conversion paths: readObject (L553) and createInstance(Collection) (L252) call createInstance(long), which for non-ArrayList instanceType tries reflective default construction; Arrays$ArrayList has no no-arg constructor (BeanUtils.getDefaultConstructor returns null), so it will NPE at setAccessible or throw 'create list error'. Review createInstance(long) handling for CLASS_ARRAYS_LIST (e.g., special-case to ArrayList with builder) and run DubboTest6 plus any tests parsing into Arrays$ArrayList.
